metadata.title: Fix Critical WCAG Color Contrast Violations

story.iWant: sufficient color contrast between text and background elements
story.soThat: I can read and navigate the video player interface without difficulty
story.tasks: - [ ] Audit existing color palette and identify non-compliant contrast ratios (AC: 1) - [ ] Install and configure axe-core for automated contrast testing - [ ] Run comprehensive contrast audit on all video player UI elements - [ ] Document all elements failing WCAG 2.1 AA standards - [ ] Update CSS color palette to meet contrast requirements (AC: 1, 2) - [ ] Modify Tailwind CSS custom properties for compliant colors - [ ] Update video player component styles with new color palette - [ ] Ensure both light and dark themes use compliant colors - [ ] Implement enhanced contrast indicators for interactive elements (AC: 2) - [ ] Add high-contrast focus states for all interactive elements - [ ] Implement hover and active states with enhanced contrast - [ ] Test contrast indicators across all interactive components - [ ] Ensure color is not only method of conveying information (AC: 3) - [ ] Add text labels or icons for color-only indicators - [ ] Implement ARIA attributes for color-coded information - [ ] Test interface with color blindness simulation - [ ] Automated accessibility testing implementation (AC: 4) - [ ] Integrate axe-core testing into development workflow - [ ] Set up WAVE API integration for automated testing - [ ] Configure CI/CD pipeline to run accessibility tests - [ ] Ensure zero contrast violations in automated tests - [ ] Cross-theme contrast compliance validation (AC: 5) - [ ] Test contrast ratios in both light and dark themes - [ ] Verify theme switching maintains contrast compliance - [ ] Document contrast compliance for all theme variations

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given video player interface is loaded, when I view any text element, then contrast ratio meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text) 2. Given video player is loaded, when I interact with any UI element, then all interactive elements have enhanced contrast indicators 3. Given video player is loaded, when I view the interface, then color is not the only method of conveying information 4. Given automated accessibility testing is run, when axe-core and WAVE tools scan the video player, then zero contrast violations are detected 5. Given both light and dark themes are active, when I switch themes, then contrast compliance is maintained in both themes
